goal:
Work autonomously on MANIFOLD’s core real-time kick detector for a bounded research run. Seek an accurate, reliable detector across full mixes, with few missed kicks, false triggers or duplicates.

Budget and autonomy
- Work for up to three hours from starting this goal.
- Use up to two Astra workers alongside the lead for independent experiments, diagnosis and review.
- Check account usage at startup, approximately every20 minutes and before substantial new work. Preserve20% of the reported allowance. Report unavailable usage information honestly.
- Reserve the final30 minutes for verification, preservation and reporting.
- Make routine research and implementation decisions without asking me. Keep progress updates concise.

Starting evidence
- Preserve the existing15-feature baseline:223/381 matched kicks within±70ms, with89 unmatched triggers.
- Review previous experiments before proposing replacements. Do not repeat failed approaches without a specific new explanation.
- Treat existing annotations as provisional. Correct demonstrated errors transparently and rescore every compared baseline under identical labels.

Research scope
- Start with nonlinear combinations of existing features and controlled mixtures using our local stems.
- You may explore bounded decision trees, small tree ensembles, regularised nonlinear scoring, competing source explanations, temporal state and past-only adaptation.
- Add DSP measurements when failure analysis identifies information worth measuring.
- Non-neural statistical learning is permitted. Keep inference CPU-only; no neural networks, GPU audio inference or external datasets.
- Stronger methods must earn their complexity through measured improvements.

Experimental discipline
- State each hypothesis, expected failure mode and acceptance criteria before running it.
- Investigate up to six materially different hypotheses, with at most three predeclared configurations each. Avoid spending the whole run on variations of one idea.
- Use all nine development songs and additional suitable local passages. Controlled stem mixtures diagnose mechanisms; actual full mixes determine detector quality.
- Split by whole song. Keep feature selection, fitting and tuning inside training folds.
- Reuse caches. Bound CPU concurrency and expensive checks.
- Combine promising components only after isolated tests establish their value.

Targets
- Ultimate success: at least95% recall and95% precision overall, at least90% recall per track, and confirmation on reserved recordings.
- Useful intermediate progress: at least223/381 matches with no more than70 extras, OR at least250/381 with no more than89 extras.
- Intermediate candidates must retain zero fires in all nine reviewed kick-free passages and lose no more than one matched kick per track.
- Intermediate progress is not final success and should guide further work within the budget.

Real-time requirements
- Use only current and past audio. Never backdate emitted triggers.
- Keep candidate observation delay at or below70ms; report actual emitted-event timing, including late detections.
- Require bounded memory and computation. Benchmark feature extraction and decision processing before claiming real-time suitability.
- Rhythm or adaptation may support acoustic evidence but must not generate kicks by prediction alone.
- Test cold starts, sustained bass, overlapping percussion, fills and changing material.

Validation and stopping
- Freeze a promising candidate before accessing reserved tracks; use them once for final evaluation and do not tune on their results.
- Stop early on verified ultimate success.
- After at least90 minutes and three distinct method families, stop for plateau if the last four completed experiments provide no improvement under the safeguards and diagnosis reveals no justified next experiment.
- Otherwise continue until the time or usage limit.
- A bounded negative result is valid completion; never claim the detector target was achieved because the research budget ended.

Delivery
Preserve verified work locally. Report the best candidate, per-track results, original174-label results, timing, duplicates, CPU cost, limitations and why experiments succeeded or failed. Include a listening comparison if there is a meaningful improvement.

No UI work, live integration, landing, public publishing or archival. Keep reserved data and unrelated work protected.
